goal: Метрика маршрута различает независимую, машинную и owner-верификацию, атрибуция событий переживает архивирование леджера, и это выпущено релизом 1.105.0.

units.criterion: itd_unit_lifecycle.attribute does not trust an explicit event ledger label that names a ledger which does not own the unit: when exactly one ledger in the memory directory owns the unit id the event is attributed to that owner, otherwise it is counted as unattributed; a label naming a ledger that owns the unit and the STATE pseudo-ledger keep their current behaviour; on the live memory directory the PE5-era lifecycles labelled GOAL.json are attributed to GOAL-2026-09-20.json with lifecyclesVerified, unattributedEvents and vcr unchanged; and the guarantee is a RED-first regression in tests/verify_ledger_reconciliation.py proved by mutation.

itd_unit_lifecycle.build assigns every verified lifecycle to exactly one named route class - verifiedIndependent (the verified event binds a checker/adjudication receipt), verifiedMachineOnly (a harness transition with a machine receipt and no checker receipt), verifiedOwnerRoute (the transition was recorded by the owner) - itd_metrics.py surfaces all three counters, their sum equals unitsVerified, vcr keeps its current value and definition, spelling variants of the route label (owner / owner-route) and the literal string none in checkerReceipt are normalised rather than trusted, and each class is a RED-first regression proved by mutation.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_route_metric.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_retro_scan.py
